referenceFunction.generalComment: The distribution of wood qualities between hard and soft wood is 28% hard wood and 72% soft wood. The volume refers to the bulked volume. The bulk density of wood chips is 239 and 169 kg/m3 of dry mass, for hard and soft wood respectively (i.e.188.6 kg/m3 of dry mass overall). Lower heating value = 3640 MJ/m3. Waste wood does not go through a specific treatment process.; UUID: 83109e15-d481-3c76-ab9c-9b5dc321621f
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This process includes transport of waste urban and demolition wood to the chopping facility (50 km), infrastructure, chopping of the wood into chips in the sawmill, consumption of water and disposal of effluents and wastes from sorting. Includes also the carbon dioxide credit. No specific treatment of the wood is considered. The gross calorific value of the biomass is not included as the product comes from waste.
